TABLE.NAME: plagiarism_dixeo_authorship
TABLE.COMMENT: Authorship confidence records: initial score, quiz, responses, final score.

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Component e.g. mod_assign

FIELD.NAME: area
FIELD.COMMENT: Type e.g. submission, forum_post

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item id for the component (e.g. submission id)

FIELD.NAME: source_timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the source record this evaluation was based on

FIELD.NAME: source_attempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Attempt number of the source record when applicable

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, verification_required, verification_in_progress or complete

FIELD.NAME: initial_confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: 0-100 score: 0=AI, 100=Human. Null while pending.

FIELD.NAME: initial_explanation
FIELD.COMMENT: Model rationale for the initial score

FIELD.NAME: quiz_data
FIELD.COMMENT: Generated quiz as JSON

FIELD.NAME: quiz_responses
FIELD.COMMENT: Student quiz responses as JSON

FIELD.NAME: response_timings
FIELD.COMMENT: Server-side quiz timing state as JSON: test_started_at, current_index, questions

FIELD.NAME: quiz_grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Objective grade 0-100 from correct answers (e.g. 3/4 = 75)

FIELD.NAME: quiz_explanation
FIELD.COMMENT: Model conclusion for the verification quiz

FIELD.NAME: quiz_question_feedbacks
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array: one short feedback line per question

FIELD.NAME: final_confidence
FIELD.COMMENT: Final score after quiz evaluation

FIELD.NAME: final_explanation
FIELD.COMMENT: Model rationale for the final score

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Student user id

INDEX.NAME: status
INDEX.COMMENT: Pending lookups for the retry task

TABLE.NAME: plagiarism_dixeo_grade_feedback
TABLE.COMMENT: Draft AI grading result for a submission attempt, pending teacher confirmation.

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Component e.g. mod_assign

FIELD.NAME: area
FIELD.COMMENT: Type e.g. submission

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item id for the component (e.g. submission id)

FIELD.NAME: source_timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: timemodified of the source record this draft was based on

FIELD.NAME: source_attempt
FIELD.COMMENT: Attempt number of the source record when applicable

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft until a teacher saves the grade, then applied

FIELD.NAME: gradingmethod
FIELD.COMMENT: simple, guide or rubric

FIELD.NAME: analysis
FIELD.COMMENT: Analysis shown to the teacher only

FIELD.NAME: feedback
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback HTML proposed for the student

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Proposed numeric grade, simple grading only

FIELD.NAME: criteria
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of proposed criterion remarks and scores for guide/rubric

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Student the draft grade is for
